construction.implementation_origin: New standalone implementation written for this build

shared_schema.input: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, policy, query, limit, records
shared_schema.policy: EU or US residency, support_research purpose, consent or contract lawful_basis, researcher role

entities.subscriber_account: kind, id (acct-* pseudonym), residency, fictional phone, synthetic IMEI, processing_allowed=true
entities.network_fault_ticket: kind, id (ticket-* pseudonym), residency, account_id, support transcript
entities.usage_record: kind, id (usage-* pseudonym), residency, account_id, cdr_csv containing exactly one usage row

shared_schema.optional_entity_field: billing_adjustment: finite amount, nonblank reason, matching residency
shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, synthetic, residency, findings[{quote,citation,score,matched_terms}], matched_passages, outcome
shared_schema.errors: One JSON object with status=error and a generic message; exit code 2, without input data or file path disclosure
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate function checks all records, references, consent/access/purpose signals, residency, CDR fields and adjustments before retrieval

cross_stage_handoffs: Single Research functionality: validate -> exact safe source passages -> deterministic lexical ranking -> extractive findings with citations

behavior.retrieval: Unique lowercased alphanumeric query-token overlap; positive matches only; descending score then record ID then source offset; bounded limit
behavior.extraction: Verbatim complete transcript lines or parsed CSV note cells; no generated factual claims
behavior.citations: Chat record ID, field, 1-based line and 0-based half-open Unicode character offsets; CSV record ID, 1-based logical row (header=1), column name. Quotes remain exact even for quoted multiline CSV cells.
behavior.protection: Raw phone/IMEI fields never returned. Known protected identifiers and bounded email/long-number/phone patterns in research text are rejected, not rewritten. Inputs and output are not persisted by the CLI.
behavior.residency: All entities, CDR rows and optional adjustments must exactly match request residency; no transfers occur
behavior.synthetic_fixtures: Explicitly synthetic input, fictional reserved-range phone, zero-prefix IMEI, invented network ticket; seeded randomized usage volumes exercised by tests

included: demonstrative GDPR/CCPA-oriented data minimization and processing controls

test_outcomes.cli_status: passed: exit 0, one JSON object, status=ok, three exact cited findings
test_outcomes.error_cli_status: verified exit 2 and JSON status=error for missing file, absent argument, invalid JSON and invalid schema
